description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory’s IM3 project deposits a TELL quickstarter data package for training hourly electricity-load models. Zenodo lists one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The linked TELL guide, opened with the record, says the package supplies compiled historical data used to train multilayer-perceptron models for 54 US balancing-authority regions; the tutorial pairs it with a separate future-weather forcing release. The TELL GitHub repository documents the Python load-projection workflow under BSD-2-Clause. This sample package can help test or teach electricity-demand simulations before switching to a full historical dataset. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this quickstarter release. A limitation is that it is a tutorial subset, not the full national demand history or an operational demand feed. The Zenodo page does not enumerate fields inside the ZIP, and model performance will depend on the tutorial preprocessing and region selection. The ZIP was not downloaded and no load model was trained.
